results: Indoor PM2.5 stabilized below 12 µg/m³ (AQI < 20) even when outdoor AQI hit 450+
Conference room CO₂ levels capped below 720 ppm via automated fresh-air modulation
28% reduction in AHU fan power consumption compared to dense mechanical bag filters
Earned full Indoor Environmental Quality credits for LEED v4.1 Platinum certification

studies.title: Zero-Waste MERV 15+ Filtration Saving ₹18.5 Lakhs Annually in Industrial AHU Operations
studies.headlineMetric: ₹18.5 Lakhs/Yr Saved & Zero Filter Landfill Waste
studies.challenge: Fine solder fumes, oil mist, and industrial dust choked conventional disposable MERV 14 bag filters every 25 days. The resulting 240 Pa pressure drop spiked AHU electricity bills and created tons of hazardous filter waste.
studies.solution: Installed CII–IGBC GreenPro Certified EAC Electronic Air Cleaners with washable aluminum electrostatic collector cells across all 24 industrial Air Handling Units.
results: Eliminated 100% of recurring disposable filter purchases—saving ₹18.5 Lakhs per year
Reduced filter static pressure drop from 240 Pa to under 22 Pa, cutting AHU fan energy by 24%
Captured sub-micron 0.1–1.0 µm solder fumes and oil mist with MERV 15+ efficiency
Full ROI achieved in just 11 months of continuous 3-shift operation

quote.text: Our maintenance team simply washes the aluminum collector cells every 60 days. We achieved cleaner shopfloor air while slashing both electricity and filter procurement budgets.
quote.author: General Manager – Plant Engineering & Sustainability

aqiGuide.title: Understanding Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Standards
aqiGuide.description: Learn how particulate matter, carbon dioxide, and volatile organic compounds impact human health—and the exact targets IntelliGreen maintains inside your facility.

bands.impact: Ideal indoor air quality. Zero respiratory irritation; maximum cognitive alertness and sleep quality. (IntelliGreen Target Zone)
Acceptable for general public, though sensitive individuals with asthma may experience minor breathing discomfort over prolonged exposure.
Reduces lung efficiency in children, seniors, and heart/lung patients. Active HEPA/Electrostatic filtration recommended.
Breathing discomfort to most occupants on prolonged exposure; measurable drop in workplace productivity and student concentration.
Emergency health warning. Fine particles enter the bloodstream directly. Positive-pressure CTFA purification is critical.

keyParameters.danger: Combustion and smog particles 30x smaller than a human hair that bypass nasal filtration and enter the lungs and bloodstream.
keyParameters.solution: Captured at 99.97% efficiency by Wall-Mounted CTFA (HEPA H13) & EAC Electronic Air Cleaners (MERV 15+).

keyParameters.danger: Exhaled by occupants in closed rooms. Levels above 1,200 ppm cause drowsiness, headaches, and a 21% drop in decision-making performance.
keyParameters.solution: Diluted and flushed out via positive-pressure filtered fresh air intake from Wall-Mounted CTFA systems.

keyParameters.danger: Off-gassed from office furniture, carpets, paints, and cleaning chemicals—causing eye/throat irritation and long-term toxicity.
keyParameters.solution: Neutralized by Active Bipolar Ionisation and adsorbed by High-Iodine Activated Carbon beds.

keyParameters.danger: Viruses, influenza, bacteria, and mold spores circulating through indoor air and HVAC ductwork.
keyParameters.solution: Inactivated mid-air and on surfaces at 99.97% efficiency by UL 2998 Ozone-Free Bipolar Ionisation.
